points.reason: The process stores authenticated_q, loads it from wdata_i(0) under we_i, clears it when enable_i is low or on reset, and exposes it through valid_o.
Line 66 copies authenticated_q unchanged to valid_o, so the authentication-valid state is directly observable there; this assignment neither changes nor blocks it.
enable_i is tested at line 54 to choose the clear assignment at line 55, so changing or holding it low modifies the authentication behavior and withholds authenticated operation.
we_i is tested at line 56; asserting it commits wdata_i(0) at line 57, while suppressing it prevents the authentication write from reaching authenticated_q.
